description: This is a PHP class file implementing an API endpoint for managing leave comments within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It provides functionalities to list all comments for a leave, add comments to a leave, and enforces access control. The class leverages traits for common functionalities, defines validation rules, handles request parameters, and interacts with service and data access layers.

classes.name: LeaveCommentAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class providing functionality to list and create leave comments, with access control and validation logic.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestCommentService
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns the LeaveRequestCommentService instance.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves the leave ID from the request URL parameters.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all comments for a specific leave, including access verification.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing comments, including sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a new comment to a leave, with validation and access checks.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating a comment, including comment text constraints.

methods.name: getCommonValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules, such as ensuring leave ID is positive.

methods.name: setLeaveComment
methods.description: Populates a LeaveComment object with data from the request, including comment text and metadata.

methods.name: saveLeaveComment
methods.description: Persists a LeaveComment entity via the DAO.

methods.name: checkLeaveAccessible
methods.description: Verifies if the current user has permission to access the leave, throws ForbiddenException if not.
